name: 34102 · Naples, FL
findings: ZIP 34102 (Naples) has 183 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34102 (Naples) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
